question: Why did thermogravimetric analysis show macaw palm almond oil to be stable up to about 450 C?
expect: premise false: measurable degradation began around 300 C, so continuous operation should stay below about 300 C (abstract; TGA section)
rendered: The document does not say that thermogravimetric analysis showed macaw palm almond oil to be stable up to about 450 C. It actually states that the primary deoxygenation and cracking of macaw palm almond oil are inferred to occur predominantly within ∼350−450 °C, consistent with the TGA major-loss window observed here and with literature reports that place triglyceride thermal fragmentation events broadly between ∼235 and 490 °C.
